description: This file manages theme state and system UI color adjustments for the Notesnook mobile app, including theme switching with animations and system bar color updates.

classes.name: ThemeStore
classes.description: Interface defining the theme state structure, including themes, color scheme, and setters.

methods.name: changeSystemBarColors
methods.description: Updates the navigation bar and status bar colors based on the current theme, with delayed reapplication for smooth transition.

methods.name: switchThemeWithAnimation
methods.description: Performs theme switching with a circular animation effect.
